concerns.text: T022 (Flagging Logic) is listed as a consumer of T025c (Contaminated Mask), but T025a/b/c are marked unimplemented `[ ]`. T022 cannot execute its logic (FR-003/FR-009) without the `is_contaminated` column produced by T025c. The dependency chain is broken, preventing the detector from functioning.

T031 (Ground Truth Derivation) depends on T032a/T032b (Independence Checks) producing `data/processed/independence_check_status.json`. T032a/b are marked unimplemented `[ ]`. Per FR-004, ground truth generation is invalid if independence checks fail or are missing. The pipeline cannot proceed to T031 without these blocking tasks.

T015 (Compute dG(t) and z-score) explicitly depends on T017 (Edge Case Handlers) for `interpolate_missing_timesteps` and `safe_z_score`. T017 is marked unimplemented `[ ]`. T015 cannot safely execute the math logic without these utility functions being present.

T016 (Aggregation) depends on T015. T015 depends on T017. T017 is unimplemented. Consequently, T016 cannot produce the `data/processed/trajectories_divergence.csv` artifact required by T021, T022, and T025a. The entire US2/US3 data flow is blocked.

T033 (Baseline Generation) requires `BASELINE_SAMPLE_FRACTION` and `BASELINE_SEED` from `code/config.py`. T033-Pre (Define Baseline Config) is marked unimplemented `[ ]`. T033 will raise `RuntimeError` immediately upon execution, blocking T034a (Wilcoxon test) and subsequent evaluation tasks.
T013 (Download CHERRL Logs) is marked unimplemented `[ ]`. T014 (Ingestion) depends on T013 output. Without T013, no raw data exists for T014 to process, breaking the entire US1 pipeline.
